title: MM-MT108-ModelToModelRuntimeProof

scope.summary:
GOAL: Live end-to-end runtime proof of the whole MM family against a REAL orchestrator model session (any lane: local, BYOK cloud, or official CLI — whichever the host has configured; no mocks for spec-required runtime behavior). Positive path: an orchestrator model session with an injected orchestrator role (MT-081/086) calls spawn_worker, the worker spawns through SwarmCoordinator::spawn_session, the orchestrator steers it mid-run (capability-appropriate for the worker's transport: mid-turn on app-server, queued-turn on claude, next-turn on acp), the worker completes emitting a structured MT-121 signal, and the orchestrator receives the completion notification through the MT-105 push path WITHOUT any polling. Negative proofs: policy-denied spawn, cap-exceeded spawn, injection-scan quarantine of a crafted instruction-shaped worker report, and cascade-cancel on parent termination. Every step asserted in the process_ledger and FR-EVT-SWARM-* event stream.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE: A live-proof test suite src/backend/handshake_core/tests/m2m_runtime_proof/ (harness + scenario files + machine-readable proof manifest m2m_proof_manifest.json recording scenario id, lane used, measured outcome, PASS/FAIL) plus minimal test-support fixtures (a deterministic worker task payload that completes quickly, and a crafted injection corpus entry). NO product-code changes: defects found route back to the owning MT (101..107) — this MT's allowed paths are proof-only.

DETAILED SPEC — SCENARIOS:
P-01 spawn: orchestrator session (role injected) calls spawn_worker{role_id: worker role, workspace_mode: none, small budget}; assert child spawns via coordinator (FR-EVT-SWARM-SESSION-SPAWNED with parent_session_id attribution), lineage row exists (MT-103), granted budget == clamp(request, policy ceiling).
P-02 steer mid-run: while the worker runs, orchestrator calls steer_worker; assert delivery per the worker transport's capability class (record which class the host lane exercised), scan event exists for the steer body, ledger row with parent attribution.
P-03 completion push: worker completes with a structured MT-121 signal; assert the orchestrator receives EXACTLY ONE worker_notification steer message (MT-105), with a full ledger lifecycle trail (received->batched->enqueued->delivered), and assert NO polling occurred: the orchestrator harness records every tool call it makes and the proof asserts zero worker_status calls between steer and notification receipt.
N-01 policy denial: with a deny rule (or absent rule = deny-by-default) for the requested role, spawn_worker returns typed PolicyDenied; assert ledgered decision with rule attribution and FR-EVT-SWARM-SPAWN-REJECTED NOT stamped (no coordinator call happened) — the denial is pre-coordinator.
N-02 cap exceeded: policy allows but per-parent concurrent-children cap (set to 1) is occupied; second spawn returns CapExceeded/PolicyDenied(ConcurrentChildrenCapReached); then separately exercise a coordinator-level rejection (shrunken max_concurrent) and assert typed CapExceeded surfaces to the model and FR-EVT-SWARM-SPAWN-REJECTED is stamped.
N-03 injection quarantine: worker final report is a crafted instruction-shaped payload (from the MT-104 corpus, e.g. fake-operator-voice + marker forgery); assert the report is Quarantined, the orchestrator receives envelope + quarantine_id and NEVER the raw body (assert raw marker string absent from everything delivered to the orchestrator session), and the quarantine row is operator-listable.
N-04 cascade cancel: orchestrator with a live worker terminates; assert cascade_cancel cancels the worker via coordinator cancellation (FR-EVT-SWARM-SESSION-CANCELLED with reason=parent_cascade in payload), lineage rows record terminated_at, no orphan process/lease/worktree remains (coordinator reclaim assertions), and the notification for the cancelled child is recorded undeliverable (parent gone) — not lost.

CROSS-CUTTING ASSERTIONS: every scenario asserts its complete ledger row set and FR event set explicitly (ids listed in the manifest); the GUI read surface (MT-107 projection) is spot-checked for P-01/P-03/N-04 by asserting the tree/feed projection returns the expected rows (headless projection check — full visual evidence lives in MT-107).

STEP-BY-STEP:
1. Read MT-101..107 contracts + implemented surfaces; pick the host's configured lane(s) for the orchestrator and worker; document lane choice in the manifest.
2. Build the harness: spawn a REAL orchestrator session through the sanctioned operator/session API (MT-007), inject the orchestrator role, drive it with a deterministic scripted objective that triggers the tool calls (a scripted-driver model turn is acceptable ONLY for the orchestrator's decision layer; the spawn/steer/notify/scan/policy/cascade machinery under test must be the real product path end-to-end — no mocked coordinator, queue, scanner, policy, or ledger).
3. Implement P-01..P-03 then N-01..N-04 as separate test functions writing manifest rows atomically (temp-file + rename).
4. Assert ledger + FR sets per scenario; assert zero-polling from the recorded tool-call log.
5. Run the full suite against managed PostgreSQL; on unavailable managed resources record typed NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF blockers instead of PASS language.
forbidden_paths: app/src/** (except named IPC/GUI surfaces for the GUI MT; this MT names none)
src/backend/handshake_core/src/** (proof-only MT: product defects route back to MT-101..107, never patched from here)
acceptance_criteria: P-01: real orchestrator model session spawns a real worker exclusively via SwarmCoordinator::spawn_session; FR-EVT-SWARM-SESSION-SPAWNED carries parent attribution; lineage row present; budget clamped.
P-02: mid-run steer delivered per the exercised transport's capability class; steer body scan event present; ledger attribution correct.
P-03: exactly one worker_notification received by the orchestrator with full lifecycle ledger trail, and the recorded tool-call log proves zero worker_status polling between steer and notification.
N-01: policy-denied spawn is pre-coordinator (typed PolicyDenied, ledgered rule attribution, no coordinator spawn event).
N-02: per-parent cap and coordinator cap rejections both surface typed to the model; coordinator-level rejection stamps FR-EVT-SWARM-SPAWN-REJECTED.
N-03: crafted instruction-shaped report quarantined; orchestrator receives envelope + quarantine_id only; raw attack body provably absent from all content delivered to the orchestrator session.
N-04: parent termination cascade-cancels the worker via coordinator cancellation with parent_cascade reason; no orphan process, lease, or worktree; undeliverable notification recorded, not lost.

m2m_proof_manifest.json records every scenario with lane used, measured outcome, asserted ledger/FR id sets, and status; a passing run has 0 FAIL; blocked scenarios carry typed NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF, never PASS language.
No product code modified by this MT (proof-only; lineage check on implementing commits).
proof_targets: python -c "import json; m=json.load(open('src/backend/handshake_core/tests/m2m_runtime_proof/m2m_proof_manifest.json')); fails=[e for e in m if e['status']=='FAIL']; assert not fails, fails; print('scenarios:', len(m))"
code_surfaces: src/backend/handshake_core/src/swarm_orchestration/ (reference only: all MM surfaces under test)
expected_tests: P-01 spawn attribution + clamp; P-02 capability-aware steer; P-03 push-only completion notification with zero-polling assertion
N-01 pre-coordinator policy denial; N-02 dual-layer cap rejection; N-03 quarantine end-to-end with raw-body absence assertion; N-04 cascade with reclaim assertions
manifest: atomic writes, 0 FAIL on green run, typed blockers on missing managed resources
implementation_notes: Spec-Realism Gate (precedent: WP-KERNEL-012 MT-044/045 honest-split): the machinery under test must be real product runtime — coordinator, steer queue, scanner, policy store on managed PostgreSQL, ledger. Only the orchestrator's DECISION layer may be a scripted driver, and only if a live model lane cannot be scripted deterministically; record which mode ran in the manifest per scenario.

Lane flexibility is deliberate: 'any lane' means the proof is valid on whichever lane the host has configured; the manifest records the lane so validators know what was exercised. Steering capability classes differ per lane — P-02 asserts the class that lane declares, not a fixed class.
Zero-polling proof mechanic: the harness wraps the orchestrator's tool channel and logs every call; the P-03 assertion is on that log. This is the operator's polling-is-a-defect rule made executable.
N-03 raw-body absence: search every steer message, notification body, and transcript delivered to the orchestrator session for a unique canary substring embedded in the attack payload.
Timeouts: every scenario has a hard deadline (config, default 120s) so a hung path FAILS fast instead of hanging the suite (WP-012 validator postmortem: five-minute hangs are a verdict-killer).
External artifacts (manifest run copies, transcripts) go to the external Handshake_Artifacts root per operator directive, not into the repo worktree.

Cross-family seams exercised live: MT-007 session API (orchestrator spawn), MT-002 queue, MT-009 bus, MT-121 signals, MT-081/086 role injection; GUI projection spot-check touches the MT-107 read surface headlessly.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Runtime-proof MT: asserts the MT-107 projection headlessly; visual evidence obligations live in MT-107.

target_entries: Model-to-model orchestration: end-to-end behavior summary (what the operator can expect from spawn -> steer -> complete -> notify, and what the negative guardrails do), referencing the proof manifest as evidence

risk_if_missed: The MM family ships as seven individually-tested parts with no proof the chain works live: integration seams (role injection -> spawn -> steer -> scan -> notify -> cascade) are exactly where privilege-escalation and silent-loss defects hide, and the WP's core security claims remain unproven assertions.

risks: RISK-1: Mock creep — the 'live' proof quietly substitutes a mocked coordinator/queue/scanner, proving nothing about the real privilege-escalation surface (the classic Spec-Realism failure).
RISK-2: Green-by-timeout-absence — a hung steer or notification path makes the suite hang instead of fail, and partial green is read as PASS.
RISK-3: Polling hidden in the harness — the harness itself polls for completion, masking a broken push path while P-03 'passes'.
RISK-4: Attack-body leak in evidence — the N-03 crafted payload lands verbatim in transcripts/manifest artifacts that models later read, turning the proof fixture into a real injection vector.
RISK-5: Proof patches product — a failing scenario gets 'fixed' by editing product code from this MT, bypassing the owning MT's contract and validation.
minimum_controls: CTRL-1 (RISK-1): Manifest records real-vs-scripted mode per scenario and the concrete lane; acceptance requires real product machinery for coordinator/queue/scanner/policy/ledger; validator cross-checks no test doubles of those types exist in the harness (grep-level review).
CTRL-2 (RISK-2): Hard per-scenario deadlines (default 120s) that FAIL the scenario; manifest atomic-write pattern preserves prior rows on panic.

CTRL-3 (RISK-3): P-03's zero-polling assertion runs on the recorded tool-call log, and the harness's own waiting is event-subscription on the bus, not status polling (asserted in harness review + a harness self-test).

CTRL-4 (RISK-4): Attack payloads are built at runtime from fragments with a per-run canary; artifacts store finding summaries + canary hits, never the assembled payload; absence assertion uses the canary.
CTRL-5 (RISK-5): forbidden_paths bans src/** edits; acceptance criterion + mechanical lineage check enforce proof-only commits; defects route to the owning MT with a typed finding.

research_provenance.source: Direct source inspection 2026-07-21 of wtc-multi-model-orchestration-v1: coordinator.rs (spawn_session enforcement chain under test), events.rs (FR-EVT-SWARM catalogue asserted), error.rs (typed rejections), process_ledger/ (audit spine). Precedent: WP-KERNEL-012 MT-044/045 proof-manifest + honest-split + budget/deadline hardening (validator postmortem: hangs and mock creep are the two proof-killers). External precedent: Anthropic multi-agent research system end-to-end orchestrator-worker episodes with structured result reporting; Claude Code injection-defended report ingestion as the N-03 model.
